newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh Truck awarded truck contract.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh Truck awarded truck contract.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said Wednesday the U.S. government awarded the company a contract for the purchase of additional palletized load system trucks and trailers.
The contract award is valued at $40.2 million.
Production of vehicles under this contract will begin in August 1997 and will extend continuous production to July 1998.

Oshkosh said it expects additional contract awards for these types of trucks that will ultimately extend production through its fiscal 1998 and beyond. The contract, it added, allows the government to purchase additional trucks at predetermined prices for several years.

This award, a modification to an existing contract, will become part of Oshkosh Truck's "family" contracts with the U.S. government. Under the family contract, Oshkosh's military vehicles of similar types are grouped together and the government has the ability to change the model mix to meet its needs.
